name: coeff_eq
goal_state:
N : ℕ
hN : 2 ≤ N
⊢ (((N - 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal))⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal ((N : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) - 1)) * ((N : ENNReal))⁻¹

candidates.proof:
intro N hN hN_ne_zero hN_real_ne_zero
  cases N with
  | zero => contradiction -- N cannot be zero since hN : N âī¥ 2
  | succ N =>
    cases N with
    | zero => contradiction -- N cannot be one since hN : N âī¥ 2
    | succ N =>
      simp_all [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub, Nat.cast_zero]
      <;> field_simp [hN_ne_zero, hN_real_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_div, ENNReal.ofReal_sub, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      <;> norm_cast
      <;> field_simp [hN_ne_zero, hN_real_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_div, ENNReal.ofReal_sub, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      <;> norm_cast
      <;> field_simp [hN_ne_zero, hN_real_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_div, ENNReal.ofReal_sub, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      <;> norm_cast
      <;> field_simp [hN_ne_zero, hN_real_ne_zero]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_div, ENNReal.ofReal_sub, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      <;> norm_cast

intro N hN
  simp_all [Nat.cast_sub, Nat.cast_ne_zero]
  <;> norm_num
  <;> aesop

intro N hN hN_ne_zero
  norm_num [hN, hN_ne_zero]
  <;> simp_all
  <;> norm_num
  <;> linarith
